docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $450.00 FILED BY BONDAREV, OLEG AS TO DEFENDANT HERNANDEZ, GEIDY ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR AUG-18-2025 AT 01:30 PM IN DEPT 506

REQUEST TO WAIVE COURT FEES AND COSTS PURSUANT TO G.C. 68633, CRC 3.51, 8.26, AND 8.818 (CONFIDENTIAL) FILED BY PLAINTIFF BONDAREV, OLEG ORDER FOR WAIVER OF COURT FEES AND COSTS GRANTED PURSUANT TO G.C. 68634 (E), CRC 3.52
PROOF OF SERVICE FILED ON CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FEE FOR SERVICE: $50.00 (WAIVED) SERVED JUL-03-2025, SUBSTITUTE SERVICE ON NATURAL PERSON AS TO DEFENDANT HERNANDEZ, GEIDY

SMALL CLAIMS CALENDAR OF AUG-18-2025 - TAKEN UNDER SUBMISSION AS OF AUG-18-2025 BY VISITING JUDGE CINDEE MAYFIELD. APPEARANCES: PLAINTIFF OLEG BONDAREV IS PRESENT. DEFENDANT GEIDY HERNANDEZ IS NOT PRESENT. CLERK: M. DE LUNA. NO EXHIBITS RETAINED. NOT REPORTED. (D506)
SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF AUG-18-2025 - JUDGMENT.

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF BONDAREV, OLEG RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT HERNANDEZ, GEIDY $450.00 PRINCIPAL, TOTAL JUDGMENT $450.00, IN COURT, THE JUDGE AWARDED $50.00 IN COSTS. HOWEVER, UPON FURTHER REVIEW, THE $50.000 SERVICE FEE WAS WAIVED. ACCORDINGLY, PLAINTIFF IS AWARDED $0 IN COSTS. STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS NO EXHIBITS FILED
